description: This file contains mock classes for testing, specifically mocking the interfaces IPackageHandler and IPackageInstaller used within the application. It defines the classes PackageManagerMock and PackageInstallerMock with mocked methods for unit testing purposes.

classes.name: PackageManagerMock
classes.description: Mock class for the IPackageHandler interface, providing mocked methods for locking, unlocking, and retrieving info about package locks.

classes.name: PackageInstallerMock
classes.description: Mock class for the IPackageInstaller interface, providing mocked methods for package installation, uninstallation, configuration, and management.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Mocks the locking of a package with given ID, version, and lock reason, returning a lock ID and associated metadata.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Mocks the unlocking of a package with given ID and version.

methods.name: GetLockedInfo
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of information about a locked package, such as its unpacked path, config metadata, gateway metadata path, and lock status.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Mocks querying for a specific interface by interface number.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Mocks registering a notification sink for package installation events.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Mocks installing a package with given ID, version, additional metadata, and file locator, returning a failure reason if applicable.

methods.name: Uninstall
methods.description: Mocks uninstalling a package identified by ID, providing an error reason if applicable.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Mocks retrieving or setting configuration for a package.

methods.name: PackageState
methods.description: Mocks querying the installation state of a package.

methods.name: GetConfigForPackage
methods.description: Mocks retrieving configuration information for a specific package.
